data.text: Welcome, Luke. My family’s fished this lake for years, and I want it to keep supporting all our livelihoods. I’m happy to commit to 10 tons this month if everyone agrees to the same limit—that’s $10,000 each while leaving enough fish to refill the lake. If someone wants less, let’s agree on any transfer before fishing so our total stays at or below 50 tons. John, does that work for you?
